description:
Log in to Moodle as admin (username: admin, password: Admin1234!) at http://localhost/moodle.

Navigate to the course "Introduction to Biology" (BIO101). Create a new Quiz activity with the following settings:

- Name: "Midterm Exam: Cell Biology"
- Description: "This exam covers topics from the cell biology unit including organelles, cell processes, and cellular structures."
- Time limit: 60 minutes
- Attempts allowed: 1

After creating the quiz, add the following two multiple-choice questions:

Question 1:
- Name: "Powerhouse of the Cell"
- Question text: "Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?"
- Choice A: "Nucleus"
- Choice B: "Mitochondria" (mark as correct answer, 100%)
- Choice C: "Ribosome"
- Choice D: "Golgi apparatus"
- Default mark: 1

Question 2:
- Name: "Basic Unit of Life"
- Question text: "What is the basic unit of life?"
- Choice A: "Atom"
- Choice B: "Molecule"
- Choice C: "Cell" (mark as correct answer, 100%)
- Choice D: "Organ"
- Default mark: 1

Save the quiz with both questions added.
